classes.complete: Built at publish time from the cell's input_specs: one edge per upstream variable, role = variable name, position 0. Positional executors use role 'input' and the index.
classes.reconstructed: Built once from a stored TransformSpec whose roles were never recorded: role 'input', positional. Partially reconstructed provenance; never replaced, never claimed equivalent to a complete node.
classes.leaf: An external input: no edges, payload = the URI without its version.

domains.payload: canonical bytes of executor plus params (the TransformSpec minus inputs)
canonical bytes of executor plus params

links.meaning: A rerun's complete node points at the historical reconstructed node; neither identity changes.
